summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a routine Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report, US equivalent of a current report) furnishing unaudited consolidated financial information for the period ended October 31, 2026. Total assets were MCh$76,530,014, with net income of MCh$1,005,679, of which MCh$980,092 is attributable to equity holders. The filing contains no transaction, no stake, no price per share, no board recommendation, and no advisor. It is an ordinary monthly financial disclosure under FMC standards; no deal or corporate-action angle to watch.
